clips.title: The story
paras: Hands Springsprocket is an industrious gnome stationed at the entrance of Coldridge Pass in Dun Morogh. He coordinates shipments between the secluded training grounds of Coldridge Valley and the town of Kharanos, though recent trogg incursions have severely hampered his efforts.

Perched at the mouth of Coldridge Pass, Hands Springsprocket finds his regular supply runs thoroughly disrupted. He routinely delivers provisions to the Thunderbrew distillery and the inn in Kharanos, but hostile Rockjaw troggs have overrun the subterranean tunnel leading out of the valley. With trade and foot traffic halted by the beasts, Hands is forced to rely on capable travelers to carry essential crates through the dangerous mountain corridor.
